description: This file implements a class `MistralLLMService` that extends the `OpenAILLMService` to provide an API-compatible interface for Mistral's language model API, ensuring features like message fixups, function call handling, and parameter building specific to Mistral.

classes.name: MistralLLMService
classes.description: A service class that integrates Mistral's API with an OpenAI-compatible interface, handling message fixups, function call execution filtering, and custom parameters for Mistral models.

methods.description: Adjusts chat messages to comply with Mistral-specific message sequence rules, such as inserting assistant responses after tools, converting misplaced system messages, and setting prefixes on assistant messages.

methods.name: run_function_calls(self, function_calls: Sequence[FunctionCallFromLLM])
methods.description: Filters out already executed function calls based on message history to avoid duplicate executions, due to differing detection patterns between Mistral and OpenAI.
